name: Gettysburg Electric Railway (trolley) along Emmitsburg Road to Wheatfield Road and the Round Tops
period_note: in operation from 1893 (CLI) and ceased operating in 1916 (CLI)

sources.cite: Cultural Landscapes Inventory: Emmitsburg Road Ridge Battlefield, Gettysburg NMP (2024), citing CLR draft 2000 and CLR 2002
sources.quote_or_paraphrase: The Gettysburg Electric Railway bordered the project area beginning in 1893 along the western side of Emmitsburg Road to Wheatfield Road.

sources.cite: Cultural Landscapes Inventory: Emmitsburg Road Ridge Battlefield, Gettysburg NMP (2024), citing CLR draft 2000 and CLR 2002
sources.quote_or_paraphrase: In 1916 the adjacent electric railroad ceased operations.

method: No geometry stored: the line ran on the western edge of the Emmitsburg Road; its remains are not mapped in the open data used here.
notes: Geometry not captured; listed so that the removal step does not treat it as 1863.
